label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, with a confident choice of a2
explanation: Fires only at GO (no activity at D1 or D2), and almost only when the model is about to pick a2 (100% of mass; essentially never on a1), with the previous trial unrewarded (99% of mass with prev_reward == 0, 0.8% after reward). The predicate uses only observed inputs (prev_reward) and the agent own policy logit (choice < -8.91, a strongly a2-favouring policy), so no future variables. Plain GO & prev_reward==0 & action==2 reaches recall 0.98 / mass 0.99 but precision 0.35; adding the strong-a2 logit threshold raises precision to 0.63 (dev F1 0.70, mass recall 0.90). Magnitude grows with the a2 confidence and is larger when the unrewarded previous trial was rare (prev_common==0, 3x lift: rare-unrewarded means stay with a2), when good==S2, late in the episode (trials 50-89) and in runs of consecutive unrewarded a2 trials; the biggest activations come at the second or third unrewarded a2 GO in a row. Adding a condition on two unrewarded trials in a row raises precision (0.77) but drops recall a lot. Does not fire after rewarded trials, on a1 choices, or at D1/D2. Precision is still incomplete: many strong-a2 GO steps after a no-reward trial stay silent.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a2 S1 u, a1 S1 u, a2 S2 u) and trial before (GO: a2 S1 u, a1 S1 u, a2 S2 r); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=7, phase=GO & ep_dec=6, phase=GO & ep_dec=5.
